[[Ready Go]] (Asia) | ja_op=[[GET BACK]] | ja_ed=[[Ready Go]] | olmteam=Team Kumemura | scenarion=1 | scenario=赤尾でこ | storyboardn=1 | storyboard=鈴 | directorn=1 | director=岩田義彦 | artn=13 | art=忍田雄介 | art2=阿部俊成 | art3=X10 | art4=董立则 | art5=沈陶裔 | art6=陈亮 | art7=何烨 | art8=郁慧云 | art9=罗睿 | art10=Brave Pictures | art11=倉谷亮多 | art12=えりある | art13=ル ラフォート | morecredits=yes | epstaffpage=HZ091-HZ100 | footnotes=* {{BMGf|307061|Preview thread on BMGf}} ''Closed'' * {{BMGf|307262|Original review thread on BMGf}} * {{BMGf|308853|Dub review thread on BMGf}} }} '''Reunion in Cortondo''' (Japanese: '''再会のセルクルタウン！''' ''Reunion in {{tt|Cercle Town|Cortondo}}!'') is the 98th episode of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', and the 1,330th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on June 6, 2025, in the United Kingdom on October 27, 2025, and in the United States on January 6, 2026. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Liko, Roy, and Ult have arrived in Cortondo to meet up with Dot and tell Murdock about their plans to restore the Rising Volt Tacklers. Murdock, who has been working as a pastry chef at Katy’s Patisserie Soapberry, is worried about the young Trainers’ safety, so Katy challenges Liko to a battle to demonstrate her skills. To everyone’s surprise (and Meowscarada’s disappointment), the Gym Leader chooses Pagogo as the opponent for her Ursaring, which is able to Terastallize into a Bug type. How will Liko and Pagogo approach this new challenge? ==Plot== [[Liko]], [[Roy]], and [[Ult]] arrive at Patisserie Soapberry in [[Cortondo]] just as [[Murdock]] enthusiastically greets [[Dot]], who arrived at the same time in a [[Flying Taxi]]. [[Katy]] exits her store to greet Liko, and everyone heads upstairs to eat some sweets. Liko and Roy introduce Ult to Murdock as {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}} creates some whipped cream for [[Pagogo]]. Seeing the whipped cream, Ult asks for some too, only for {{TP|Roy|Crocalor}}, {{TP|Dot|Tinkatuff}}, and {{TP|Roy|Kilowattrel}} to ask for some as well, causing the group to fight. Fed up with the fighting, [[Liko's Hattrem]] and [[Captain Pikachu]] set them in order, allowing Alcremie to happily make some whipped cream for the four of them. Cap is introduced to Katy, who notices Liko has an additional partner [[HZ067|since they last met]]. Roy asks about Murdock's {{p|Rockruff}}, and is happy to learn it [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{form|Lycanroc|Midday Form}} {{TP|Murdock|Lycanroc}}. When Lycanroc appears before them, almost everyone is stunned to see it chubby while Liko finds it cute, petting it along with {{TP|Dot|Quaxwell}} and Pagogo. When Dot asks how it came to be this way, Murdock sheepishly revealed it was from tasting all the sweets he made since he started working at Patisserie Soapberry after the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] disbanded. Ult continues to stuff himself with sweets as everyone is talking, but ends up choking on them. He is unable to interact with Katy well after she offers a drink to help him, and he falls over when she approaches him. Dot and {{p|Sableye}} help him up, but Ult becomes shocked when he finds out Dot is actually a girl, unable to discern from the [[Rotom Phone]] this whole time. [[File:Katy Teddy High Horsepower.png|thumb|left|250px|Pagogo vs. Teddy]] Trying to divert the attention away, Ult brings up the [[Explorers]], [[Exceed]], and the [[Strong Sphere]]. Dot bluntly reveals they're starting their adventure again, with Liko and Roy explaining they reformed the Rising Volt Tacklers to retrieve the truth and expose the Explorers. Katy is pleased to see the kids have created their own path while Murdock becomes concerned for them. Despite Liko's attempts to ease his worries, Murdock remains unconvinced. Katy suggests having a {{pkmn|battle}} with Liko to alleviate Murdock's worries, which she agrees to. The [[Gym Leader]] then reveals that her {{p|Teddiursa}}, Teddy, has evolved into {{p|Ursaring}}, before choosing Pagogo as her opponent, catching the others off-guard. At the battlefield, Pagogo {{a|Tera Shift|transforms}} into its {{form|Terapagos|Terastal Form}} before the battle starts. Katy begins by having Teddy use {{m|High Horsepower}}, which Pagogo blocks with {{m|Protect}} before using {{m|Ancient Power}} that is smacked away by Teddy with {{m|Hammer Arm}}. Teddy keeps on the offensive by attacking with {{m|Fury Cutter}}, shattering Pagogo's Protect and sending it flying. Liko sends Pagogo straight to Teddy with a plan in mind. When the two Pokémon are close enough, Katy attempts to have the {{pkmn|category|Hibernator Pokémon}} use Hammer Arm to beat down Pagogo, but Liko has it attack with {{m|Rapid Spin}} to land some attacks. Impressed by Liko's growth, Katy {{Tera}}stallizes Teddy into the {{t|Bug}} type. Pagogo attacks with Ancient Power, its stats increasing in the process, as Teddy charges towards the Tera Pokémon with a flurry of Fury Cutters. Pagogo holds on until it makes a signal to Liko, who has it use {{m|Tera Starstorm}}, successfully overwhelming and defeating Teddy. [[File:Liko Roy Dot.png|thumb|250px|Liko, Roy and Dot agreeing to get the Brave Olivine]] While the others congratulate Liko on her win, Murdock tells Liko she had shown him what one would expect from a Rising Volt Tackler, completely alleviated of his worries. Now that Murdock is in the loop, Ult suggests moving on elsewhere. As Roy and Ult argue, Dot agrees with going elsewhere now, but prefers to gather information for their investigation at the same time. As one, the three young Rising Volt Tacklers realize they need the [[Brave Olivine]]. To Liko and Dot's dismay, Murdock reveals [[Orla]] planned to dismantle the airship after they separated. However, Roy and Ult come up with the idea of asking Orla to make a new airship for them. With a plan set in course, the kids set off to meet Orla while Murdock and Katy see them off. Shortly after, Murdock reveals despite being the one who declared the Rising Volt Tacklers should disband in order to not hold the kids back, he still wanted to travel with everyone. Katy advises Murdock he could still fly since Liko and the others have done so despite their complicated circumstances, making Murdock come to a realization of his own. {{-}} ==Major events== * [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] reunite with [[Dot]] in person, while [[Ult]] meets her for the first time. * Liko, Roy, and Dot reunite with [[Murdock]] and [[Katy]], with Ult meeting them for the first time. * Murdock's {{p|Rockruff}} is revealed to have evolved into a {{form|Lycanroc|Midday Form}} {{TP|Murdock|Lycanroc}}. * Katy's {{p|Teddiursa}}, {{DL|Katy|Teddy}}, is revealed to have evolved into an {{p|Ursaring}}. * Liko uses [[Pagogo]] in an official {{pkmn|battle}} for the first time. * Pagogo is revealed to know {{m|Rapid Spin}}. * Liko has a [[rematch]] against Katy and wins. * Murdock reveals that [[Orla]] planned to dismantle the [[Brave Olivine]] after the events at [[Laqua]]. * The group decides to travel to find Orla. {{animeevents|HZ}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * [[Murdock's Lycanroc]] ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Liko]] * [[Roy]] * [[Dot]] * [[Ult]] * [[Murdock]] * [[Katy]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Meowscarada}} ({{OP|Liko|Meowscarada}}) * {{p|Hattrem}} ({{OP|Liko|Hattrem}}) * {{p|Terapagos}} ([[Liko]]'s;
